variables.name: caller_name
variables.description: Full name of the caller, either confirmed from metadata or explicitly collected during the call.

variables.name: city
variables.description: Target city where the caller is looking for PG accommodation.

variables.name: preferred_locality
variables.description: Specific neighborhood or landmark mentioned by the caller (e.g. DLF Phase 3, Koramangala, OMR, near office). Empty string if not specified.

variables.name: gender_pg_type
variables.description: Gender preference or room type requested by caller.

variables.name: monthly_budget
variables.description: Expected monthly budget in INR (e.g. '12000', '15000-18000'). Standardize mentions like '15k' into '15000'.

variables.name: move_in_date
variables.description: Approximate date or timeline for shifting (e.g. 'Immediate', '1st Nov', 'Within 2 weeks').

variables.name: stay_duration
variables.description: Duration of PG stay (e.g. '3 months', '6 months', '1 year', 'Short term').

variables.name: call_outcome
variables.description: Final lead qualification outcome of the call.

variables.name: callback_time
variables.description: Time requested for callback if caller was busy, or 'WhatsApp' if preferred.

variables.name: call_summary
variables.description: Concise 1-2 sentence executive summary of the caller's requirements, preferences, and next steps.
